import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date and time to datetime
coffee_sales['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'] + ' ' + coffee_sales['time'])
coffee_sales['hour'] = coffee_sales['datetime'].dt.hour

# Aggregate sales by hour and product
sales_by_hour = coffee_sales.groupby(['hour', 'product']).agg({'total': 'sum'}).reset_index()

# Set the style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create the bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(data=sales_by_hour, x='hour', y='total', hue='product', palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Total Coffee Sales by Hour and Product', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Hour of the Day', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(range(24), [f'{h}:00' for h in range(24)], rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Product', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
